title: A New Look at Bayesian Testing
summary: We identify the critical deviation scale governing Bayesian evidence accumulation in regular parametric testing. Under integrated Bayes risk with zero-one loss, the risk-optimal rejection boundary lies in a moderate deviation regime, with a square-root logarithmic inflation relative to the usual local asymptotic normal scale.
